name: insert_char_and_shift_buffer
description: Library code that shifts the bytes of a buffer one place towards its end and writes a fixed character into the freed slot. It then stores the advanced pointer into a field of a structure and returns.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only one instruction could be decoded and it is not valid code, so the body is an empty stub. It has no recoverable behaviour.

name: store_library_state
description: Library code that saves the library base and one incoming register value into two globals. It also writes another incoming value into a field 34 bytes into the structure passed in, and stores that value in a third global.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Library code that makes a single call to another routine and then returns, adding nothing of its own.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Library code that calls one helper routine and returns straight afterwards, with no other work in its body.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns immediately afterwards, with no other work.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns immediately afterwards, with no other work.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains a single return instruction and does no work when called.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears one flag bit in a byte of the structure passed in and increments a 16-bit counter at a later offset in the same structure. It returns the structure pointer.

name: branch_on_counter_state
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then branches on a 16-bit counter in the structure. When the counter is zero it calls three routines using two 16-bit size fields, otherwise it sets bit 8 of a flag byte, makes one call and returns 0.

name: call_routines_with_computed_args
description: Saves a global value, calls one unnamed routine, then passes a computed offset and sum from two 16-bit structure fields to another routine. It calls a third routine, then returns the saved value.

name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in the structure. When the counter reaches zero and bit 8 of a flag byte is set, it calls another routine and returns that result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without performing any other work.

name: call_nonzero_pointers_conditionally
description: Calls a routine for each non-zero pointer among its arguments and several global pointers. The second argument is passed together with a flag value of 1.

name: initialize_info_block_from_template
description: Requests a block from a library function and, on success, stores fixed offsets into it in several globals. It then copies several ten-entry templates from a global area into the block and returns 1, or returns 0 when the request fails.

name: initialize_info_library_struct
description: Computes many pointers as fixed offsets from a base pointer and stores them in globals and in a structure. It then copies several ten-entry templates from a global area into those locations and returns 1.

name: acquire_three_handles_or_fail
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times with zero arguments, storing each result in a global. On the first failed result it reports a failure number of 3, 4 or 5 to another routine and returns 0, otherwise it returns 1.

name: acquire_three_handles_indirect
description: Performs the same three acquisitions as its neighbour, but calls through function pointers held in address registers. It reports the failure number through another pointer and returns 1 only when all three results are non-zero.

name: acquire_two_handles_indirect
description: Calls a function pointer twice and stores each result in a global. It reports failure number 4 or 5 through a second pointer and returns 1 only when both results are non-zero.

name: acquire_one_handle_indirect
description: Calls a function pointer and stores the result in a global. When that result is zero it reports failure number 5 through a second pointer, and it returns whether the result was non-zero.

name: stub_return_one
description: Returns one without performing any other work.

name: get_cached_or_derived_long
description: Returns a 32-bit value stored in a global structure if one is set. Otherwise it follows a pointer chosen by a type byte and returns a 32-bit field from the structure it reaches, or zero when the global is null or the type byte has a special value.

name: get_cached_long_from_pointer
description: Returns a stored 32-bit value from the structure in the address register when present. Otherwise it follows a pointer selected by a type byte and returns a 32-bit field from the target, or zero when the pointer is missing.

name: get_stored_or_chained_long
description: Returns a stored 32-bit value when one is present. Otherwise it follows a chained pointer chosen by a type byte and returns a 32-bit field from the target, or zero when no pointer is available.

name: read_long_from_chained_pointer
description: Follows a pointer chosen by a type byte, either a structure field or a pointer argument, and returns the 32-bit value at a fixed offset in the target. It returns zero when the argument pointer is null.

name: read_long_via_field_pointer
description: Returns a 32-bit value found at a fixed offset in the structure referenced by a field of its argument. It returns zero when the argument pointer is null.

name: copy_name_and_resolve_info
description: Gets a value from an unnamed routine and stores it in a field of a structure. It copies a string into a local 116-byte buffer, calls an unnamed routine on that buffer with a code of -2, and when the result is zero and a type byte is 1 it returns a 32-bit field from a chained structure and sets a global flag.

name: resolve_name_and_set_flag
description: Calls two unnamed routines on a local 116-byte buffer, the second with a code of -2, and clears a global flag. When that result is zero and a type byte is 1, it sets the flag and returns a 32-bit field from a chained structure, otherwise it returns the call result.

name: allocate_paired_blocks_and_init
description: Obtains two blocks from a library function and checks each is non-zero. It then runs optional checks through unnamed routines, stores a computed count of at least 256 into the first block, and obtains a further block, returning 1 on success or 0 otherwise.

name: allocate_block_and_set_count
description: Obtains a block through an unnamed routine and stores it in a pointer argument. When the block and the optional checks succeed, it stores a computed count of at least 256 into a structure and obtains one more block, returning 1 on success.

name: configure_block_with_count
description: Runs optional status checks through unnamed routines and stores a computed count of at least 256 in a field of a block. It then obtains another block and links it to the structures, returning 1 on success and 0 when a check fails.

name: link_block_with_count
description: Stores a computed count of at least 256 in a field of a block and obtains another block through an unnamed routine. When that succeeds it links the block to the structures and returns 1.

name: finish_block_setup_and_report
description: Stores a computed count of at least 256 into a block, obtains a further block and copies two fields into it when that succeeds. It returns true when the block was obtained and false otherwise.

name: call_routine_then_copy_fields
description: Calls one unnamed routine with a field from one structure and a field from a second structure. It then copies a further 32-bit field from a third structure into a fixed slot and returns 1.

name: setup_info_state_or_report
description: Clears several global pointers and stores its second argument in a global. It then obtains a block and a stack record and links them through a sequence of unnamed calls, reporting failure codes 1, 5, 6 or 7 through another routine when a step fails.

name: setup_info_state_pointer_out
description: Performs the same obtain-and-link sequence as its neighbour, storing the new pointer into a caller-supplied slot. On a failed step it reports failure codes 1, 5, 6 or 7 through a pointer held in an address register.

name: setup_info_state_from_handle
description: Obtains a stack record and a block through unnamed routines, links them into the structures and stores a value into a caller slot. It reports failure codes 1, 5 or 7 through a pointer held in an address register.

name: link_block_and_report_failure
description: Obtains a record through an unnamed routine, stores a global-based value in a passed pointer and links the record to the structures. On failure it reports code 7, 5 or 1 through a function pointer.

name: finish_block_link_and_report
description: Links a block to the structures through several unnamed calls, using a value from a global structure. It reports code 7 through a function pointer on failure and returns after the final calls.

name: finish_info_setup_report
description: Links a block and its structures through a sequence of unnamed calls and reports code 1 through a function pointer if the setup fails. It returns without a value.

name: finish_setup_with_status_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, if its result is zero, reports code 1 through a function pointer held in an address register. Otherwise it runs four unnamed routines, one of them conditionally, and reports code 0 through the same pointer.

name: run_conditional_calls_then_report
description: Runs one unnamed routine only when a global flag is clear and an argument is non-zero, then runs four further unnamed routines. It reports code 0 through a function pointer held in an address register and returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_132
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 132 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_138
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 138 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_198
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 198 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_210
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 210 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_246
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 246 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_294
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 294 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_372
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 372 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_378
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 378 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_414
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 414 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_552
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 552 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_42
description: Loads a library base from a second global variable and calls the library function 42 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_96
description: Loads a library base from a second global variable and calls the library function 96 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_228
description: Loads a library base from a second global variable and calls the library function 228 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_366
description: Loads a library base from a second global variable and calls the library function 366 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_462
description: Loads a library base from a second global variable and calls the library function 462 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Loads a library base from a third global variable and calls the library function 72 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_78
description: Loads a library base from a third global variable and calls the library function 78 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_234
description: Loads a library base from a third global variable and calls the library function 234 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_270
description: Loads a library base from a third global variable and calls the library function 270 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_354
description: Loads a library base from a third global variable and calls the library function 354 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: fill_record_and_call_routine
description: Fills a local record with fixed constants, a value from a global and a field from another structure, then passes it to an unnamed routine. When that routine returns non-zero, it calls two more routines with the record value, the all-ones argument and a global, and returns the value.

name: dispatch_by_record_type
description: Switches on a 16-bit type field of the record in its first argument. Each case calls an unnamed routine with a stored value or record field and returns a fixed status, with some types storing a flag when a lookup fails.

name: stub_return_one
description: Returns one without performing any other work.

name: toggle_flag_bit_by_type
description: Maps a record's type value to one of seven single-bit masks and toggles that bit in a stored flag word. The flag word is left unchanged for other types, and an unnamed routine is then called with a field from the record.

name: store_value_then_call_routine
description: Stores its incoming register value into a field of a stored record, then calls an unnamed routine with a field taken from the record passed in an address register.

name: build_info_path_and_validate
description: Formats a path from two text pieces ending in an info extension, then checks it through several unnamed routines and library calls. It updates a stored field for two type values and returns true only when all checks pass.

name: check_disk_path_status
description: Formats a path into a stack buffer using a disk text or a stored pointer, then checks it through an unnamed routine. It then checks two stored values and a masked flag, returning zero when any check fails.

name: validate_info_entry_fields
description: Copies text into a stack buffer and checks a stored record through unnamed routines. It compares two stored values and a masked flag, returning zero if any check fails.

name: check_four_entries_then_run
description: Calls an unnamed routine with four different global pointers and the all-ones argument. If any call returns that value it returns 0, otherwise it runs one more routine and returns 1.

name: check_three_calls_then_run
description: Calls a function pointer three times and returns 0 if any result is the all-ones value. Otherwise it runs one unnamed routine and returns 1.

name: check_two_calls_then_run
description: Calls a function pointer twice and returns 0 if either result is the all-ones value. Otherwise it runs one unnamed routine and returns 1.

name: run_if_call_succeeds
description: Calls a function pointer and, unless the result is the all-ones value, runs one unnamed routine. It returns whether the result was not the all-ones value.

name: call_routine_and_return_one
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns one afterwards.

name: initialize_info_table_entries
description: Calls one unnamed routine 24 times with fixed numeric constants describing ranges and positions. The first call takes a field from the input structure and the last three take a global variable.

name: register_seven_table_entries
description: Calls one unnamed routine seven times, each time with the same first argument and fixed range constants.

name: register_seven_range_entries
description: Calls one unnamed routine seven times, passing the same first argument with fixed numeric constants for flags and ranges.

name: register_nine_table_entries
description: Calls one unnamed routine nine times, each time with the same first argument and fixed numeric constants for flags and ranges.

name: register_nine_range_entries
description: Calls one unnamed routine nine times with the same first argument and fixed numeric constants for flags and ranges.

name: select_entry_layout_by_type
description: Chooses one of two numeric constants from a type byte. It then either calls an unnamed routine with fixed numeric constants and a second routine, or passes a stored list to one unnamed routine, and calls one more routine when the second argument is non-zero.

name: process_entry_list_state
description: Runs one of two unnamed call sequences depending on whether a stored list has reached its end marker. The first passes a field from the record to a routine, the second makes a single call, and a non-zero flag argument triggers one more call with a stored value.

name: run_entry_callbacks_with_field
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from its base, then passes a field of the record to a second routine. A third routine is called with a stored value when the flag argument is non-zero.

name: allocate_linked_entry_list
description: Obtains a block through a library function and makes it the head of a circular list. For each value in a zero-terminated table it obtains a further block, stores the value in it and appends it, returning 0 when a block cannot be obtained.

name: append_entries_from_table
description: Links the existing head block into a list, then for each value in a zero-terminated table obtains a further block, stores the value in it and appends it. It returns early when a block cannot be obtained.

name: append_table_entries_loop
description: Loops over a zero-terminated table, obtaining a block for each value, storing the value in it and appending it to the list. It returns 0 if a block cannot be obtained, otherwise it updates the list head and returns the last result.

name: append_table_entries_from_block
description: Stores a value from a zero-terminated table into a supplied block and appends it to the list, obtaining a new block for each further value. It updates the list head at the end and returns the last result, or 0 if a block cannot be obtained.

name: advance_list_entry_or_insert
description: If the list head is at an end marker, or the entry before it is the list start, it calls a library function and two routines with fields of the record. Otherwise it calls two routines with stored values, moves the head to the entry in its second link, and runs one more routine with a flag of 0.

name: advance_list_head_and_notify
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a field from the current list head and a stored value, then calls another routine. It moves the list head to the entry in its second link and calls a final routine.

name: step_list_head_or_finish
description: If the list head is at an end marker, it calls a library function and two routines with fields of the record argument. Otherwise it calls two routines with stored values, moves the head to the entry its first link points to, and runs one more routine with a flag of 0.

name: advance_list_head_via_link
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a field from the current list head and a stored value, then calls another routine. It replaces the list head with the entry its first link points to and calls a final routine.

name: insert_entry_and_mark_busy
description: Sets a state flag, and if the list is not at its end it calls two routines with stored values. It obtains a block through a library function, stores a value in it, makes it the new head and calls a routine with a flag of 1.

name: advance_list_head_and_mark
description: Sets a state flag, then either calls two routines and a third with a record field, or moves the list head to a neighbouring entry chosen by comparing links. It finishes by calling one routine with a flag of 0.

name: reset_list_head_and_notify
description: Calls an unnamed routine with the current list entry, then moves the head to the first entry of the list, or to the last entry when the list is at its end. It finishes by calling a library function at a fixed offset.

name: run_entry_callbacks_in_order
description: Makes one unnamed call, then calls two routines with the fields at offsets 46 and 62 of its record argument, in that order.

name: allocate_per_entry_pointer_table
description: When a pending flag is set, it rebuilds a pointer table for the list. It counts the entries, obtains a table sized to them, and for each entry obtains a block sized from that entry and fills it, returning 0 if any allocation fails.

name: build_entry_pointer_table
description: Rebuilds a pointer table for the list using an address-register record, counting the entries and obtaining one block per entry. It clears the table pointer when the list is empty and returns 0 if any allocation fails.

name: rebuild_entry_pointer_table
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a stored value, then counts the list entries and obtains a pointer table sized to them. It fills the table with one obtained block per entry and returns 0 when an allocation fails and 1 otherwise.

name: fill_entry_pointer_table
description: Counts the list entries and obtains a pointer table sized to them. For each entry it obtains a block, stores it in the table and fills it, returning 0 when an allocation fails and 1 otherwise.

name: fill_entry_blocks_from_table
description: Copies data into an existing pointer table, then for each list entry obtains a block, stores it in the table and fills it. It returns 1 when the list is exhausted and 0 if an allocation fails.

name: fill_entry_blocks_loop
description: Loops over the list from its current entry, obtaining a block for each entry sized from its value, storing the block in the table and copying data into it. It returns 1 when the list ends and 0 when a block cannot be obtained.

name: continue_entry_block_fill
description: Copies data into the current table slot, advances to the next list entry and obtains a block sized from its value. It returns 1 when the list is exhausted and 0 when a block cannot be obtained.

name: call_library_vector_90
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 90 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: dispatch_layout_by_mode
description: Switches on a mode byte in a stored record and makes a fixed sequence of unnamed routine calls with numeric constants and stored values for each mode. Mode 1 selects one of several constants from a stored count, and mode 6 makes a single call.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains a single return instruction and does no work when called.

name: allocate_mode_dependent_blocks
description: Obtains four blocks through a library function and, only if all are non-zero, obtains four more of fixed sizes. It then runs a mode-dependent sequence of unnamed routine calls and returns the final result, 0 when an allocation fails, or the mode value when no case applies.

name: allocate_mode_steps_via_pointer
description: Calls a function pointer four times, storing the last result in a caller slot. It returns 0 when any result is zero, otherwise it runs between one and four unnamed routines chosen by a mode byte and returns the result of the final call.

name: run_mode_dependent_call_sequence
description: Makes a mode-dependent number of unnamed routine calls: two for mode 1, three for modes 2 and 5, four for mode 3 and five for mode 4. It does not return a value.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains a single return instruction and does no work when called.

name: clear_or_copy_optional_entry
description: If a stored pointer is null it clears a global target, otherwise it calls an unnamed routine to copy into that target. It then calls a routine with a global value and returns that result, or 0 when the result is the all-ones value.

name: copy_entry_then_check_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine to copy from a stored pointer into a target, then calls another routine. It returns 0 when that result is the all-ones value, otherwise it returns the result.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains a single return instruction and does no work when called.

name: set_fields_and_check_four
description: When the mode is not 4, it writes four 16-bit values into fixed fields of stored records. It then calls an unnamed routine with four records and returns 0 if any call returns the all-ones value, otherwise 1.

name: check_three_calls_succeed
description: Calls a function pointer three times and returns 0 if any result is the all-ones value, otherwise 1.

name: check_two_calls_succeed
description: Calls a function pointer twice and returns 0 if either result is the all-ones value, otherwise 1.

name: check_single_call_succeeds
description: Calls a function pointer once and returns whether its result is not the all-ones value.

name: stub_return_one
description: Returns one without performing any other work.

name: process_pending_entries_loop
description: Loops forever fetching entries through an unnamed routine. For each entry it calls a second routine with the caller's second argument and returns 0 if that fails, and when no entry is available it calls a routine with a single-bit mask taken from a byte in the record.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without performing any other work.

name: dispatch_by_status_code
description: Compares a status value in the record with special codes: a status of 4 calls a routine with a record field and then continues, 64 returns the result of another routine, and 512 calls a routine and returns 0. Other statuses end with one final call that returns 1.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns immediately afterwards, with no other work.

name: call_routine_then_return_zero
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and then returns zero.

name: call_two_routines_return_one
description: Makes two calls to unnamed routines in sequence and returns one.

name: run_entry_callback_sequence
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times with the same argument, and once more when the record's type byte is not 1. It then calls a routine with a field at offset 62 of the record and finishes with a call using a flag of 1.

name: format_protection_flag_strings
description: Derives four bit values from a stored flag word and formats each one through an unnamed routine with a global text pointer. The four bits correspond to the labels archived, deleteable, readable and writeable.

name: format_flag_status_line
description: Selects one of two string fragments according to a flag argument and builds a text from them. It passes that text and a character looked up from a four-entry table to two formatting routines with fixed numeric arguments.

name: format_string_argument_list
description: Formats a temporary text buffer from two string pieces and a value taken from the caller's frame. It then makes two further calls with that buffer.

name: measure_string_length
description: Returns the number of bytes before the terminating zero byte of a text at the given address.

name: count_bytes_until_terminator
description: Returns the offset of the first zero byte in a text, counted from a base address given in a data register.

name: copy_cstring_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated text from the source address to the destination, including the terminating zero byte.

name: copy_fixed_length_bytes
description: Copies a given number of bytes from the source address to the destination address, one byte at a time.

name: copy_bytes_from_registers
description: Copies bytes from the source to the destination using register inputs, one byte at a time, until the counter reaches the count.

name: compare_strings_for_equality
description: Compares two zero-terminated texts, advancing through them while their characters match, and returns whether the characters where they stop are equal.

name: compare_register_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated texts whose addresses are in address registers and returns whether the characters where they stop are equal.

name: measure_string_including_terminator
description: Returns the number of bytes in a zero-terminated text, counting the terminating zero byte.

name: run_three_library_operations
description: Obtains a value from an unnamed routine, then calls three library-backed routines on a base taken from a field of the first argument. The first receives an argument reduced by 10, the second the second argument, and the third the obtained value.

name: call_string_formatter
description: Formats text from a global pointer and an extra argument into a local 12-byte buffer. It then passes that buffer with the other arguments to a second routine.

name: copy_counted_string_with_terminator
description: Reads a length value from a byte at a computed address, copies that many bytes from the source into the destination, and writes a zero byte after them.

name: copy_bytes_and_terminate
description: Copies a counted run of bytes from the source to the destination and appends a zero byte after the last one.

name: initialize_entry_record_and_add
description: Fills two new structures from its parameters, storing sizes, positions and flags into fixed fields, and calls two unnamed routines with them. It then adds the record through another routine and, when the add succeeds, calls one more routine and returns true.

name: call_library_with_record_field
description: Passes a field at offset 62 of the record in an address register to a library function at a fixed offset, then returns one.

name: call_library_sequence_with_fields
description: Calls library functions in sequence on a base taken from the field at offset 50 of the first argument. The calls use the second argument, zero, and the remaining arguments, with the fifth and sixth arguments each reduced by 10.

name: call_raw_format_function
description: Calls the exec library's formatting function through a global base, using the arguments the caller has already set up. It returns nothing.

name: store_byte_at_address
description: Writes the low byte of the data register into the byte at the address held in an address register.

name: call_library_vector_36
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 36 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function 72 bytes before that base. It returns nothing and passes no arguments.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without performing any other work.

name: store_register_values_in_struct
description: Stores a register value and a second register value into two fixed fields of the structure addressed by the data register, then returns.

name: increment_counter_and_clear_flag
description: Increments the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure in the frame register and clears bit 3 of the byte at offset 42 in the same structure.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure. When it reaches zero and bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 42 is set, it calls another routine and returns its result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: finish_counter_or_flag_entry
description: If the counter at offset 32 is zero, it reads the value at offset 38, calls two library functions on a base stored at offset 34, and returns the value. Otherwise it sets bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 42 and returns zero.

name: read_value_around_library_calls
description: Reads a 32-bit value from offset 38 of the structure in one address register, then calls two library functions on the base in another register. It returns the value read first.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without performing any other work.

name: init_custom_chips_open_graphics
description: Writes custom-chip registers, including interrupt enable and DMA control, to disable interrupts and enable DMA. It clears a block of memory, waits on a status bit, and then uses exec functions to open the graphics library and close another library.

name: fetch_char_and_blit_glyph
description: Fetches the next character from a text pointer when needed and finds its index in a fixed alphabet string. It waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its control, modulo and pointer registers, and fills a block using a table-driven offset.

name: blit_block_grid_from_table
description: Programs the blitter across a 20 by 8 grid of blocks, writing source, destination and size registers for each block and waiting for the blitter between blocks. It updates a pseudo-random shift register and a value derived from it at the end.

name: toggle_bit_and_wait_loop
description: Toggles one bit in a byte at the address held in an address register and clears all but two bits of a nearby word. It then runs a 30-iteration loop, polling a second routine each time until it returns zero.

name: clear_masked_word_and_wait
description: Keeps only two bits of a word at a fixed negative offset from an address register, clearing the rest. It then runs the same 30-iteration polling loop as its neighbour.

name: poll_status_thirty_iterations
description: Runs a fixed 30-iteration loop, calling an unnamed routine on each pass and polling a second routine until it returns zero.

name: start_blit_with_pointers
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then programs its control, mask, modulo, source and destination pointer registers, and starts a blit by writing its size register.

name: fill_words_from_table_count
description: Looks up a count byte in a table, indexed by the data register, and calls two routines around that lookup. It then fills that many 32-bit words with a fixed value from a pointer, or 16 words at a fixed address when the index is zero.

name: fill_words_with_fixed_value
description: Writes a fixed value into a run of 32-bit words starting at the address in an address register, with the count given in the data register.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly until it returns zero.

name: swap_global_longs_and_split
description: Swaps two 32-bit global variables, then stores the low word and the high word of the old first value into two word-sized globals.

name: swap_global_longs_and_split
description: Swaps two 32-bit global variables, then stores the low word and the high word of the old first value into two word-sized globals.

name: setup_four_audio_channels
description: Programs four audio channel register blocks with a shared sample pointer, a length of 13, a volume of 64 and periods that rise in steps of 4. It then writes the DMA control register to enable the four channels.

name: increment_byte_triplets_in_table
description: Walks 110 records spaced 24 bytes apart and adds 1, 2 and 3 to three bytes in each record.

name: fill_table_records_with_pattern
description: Writes fixed values into 140 six-long records starting at one address. It then fills 110 eight-byte records at a lower address with an incrementing pattern of character values and clears the fourth byte of each.

name: copy_header_block_then_call
description: If its pointer argument is not null, copies sixteen 32-bit values from a structure at offset 536 into the target. It then calls a routine held in an address register.

name: run_optional_handler_then_branch
description: Calls an unnamed routine and stores results in globals. When a flag bit in a structure is set it calls a library function with the saved register values, then calls a library function and calls one of two routines depending on whether its result is zero.

name: call_three_unnamed_routines
description: Calls three unnamed routines, as listed in its call facts. No decompiled body is available, so what it does with them is not described.

name: copy_global_word
description: Copies the value of one global 16-bit variable into another global 16-bit variable.

name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Updates a 16-bit global state by multiplying it by 1453 and adding 18269. It returns the high word of the product together with the new state halved.

name: initialize_copper_dma
description: Allocates memory blocks through library calls and builds a copper list table of per-row pointers from offsets. It writes the copper pointer and DMA control registers, and its text includes a graphics file path and a prompt to remove write protection and press a key.

name: open_exec_and_intuition_libraries
description: Opens two libraries by name through library calls and calls an error routine if either is missing. When a flag is set and a bit in the second library's structure is set, it runs a short sequence of calls and then passes the second library base to a further routine.

name: call_two_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns.

name: store_global_parameters
description: Stores its first argument as a 32-bit global variable and the low 16 bits of its second argument in the following global location.

name: expand_control_byte_stream
description: Reads a header to choose one of two modes. In the second mode it expands a stream of control bytes: a control byte with its high bit clear repeats the next byte for its low seven bits plus one, and otherwise it copies that many following bytes.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines, as listed in its call facts. No decompiled body is available, so its behaviour beyond those calls is not described.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains a single return instruction and does no work when called.

name: enable_dma_and_report_error
description: Calls an unnamed routine that reports a status through a stack word, then writes the DMA control register to enable DMA channels. When the status is non-zero it calls a routine with the disk I/O error text.

name: load_backpiece_table_entries
description: Loads a count from an unnamed routine and reports an overflow message when it exceeds 479. It adds a base value to each entry of a table, writes a sentinel of 1000 after the last entry, and when its argument is non-zero it loads backdrop graphics files named in its text.

name: setup_config_table_entries
description: Computes positions from a stored value and calls unnamed routines with fixed values, using text that names a configuration file. It writes table entries in one of two layouts and writes the DMA control register.

name: invert_flag_and_setup_entries
description: Inverts a flag byte in a frame-relative record. Depending on a state flag it either builds two small structures with fixed values and writes the DMA control register according to a status, or calls routines with positions computed from a stored value.

name: setup_disk_or_display_entries
description: Chooses between two setups based on a state flag. One path builds two small structures with fixed values, calls a routine, and writes the DMA control register according to its status; the other path calls routines with positions computed from a stored value.

name: setup_disk_or_display_entries
description: Chooses between two setups based on a state flag. One path builds two small structures with fixed values, calls a routine, and writes the DMA control register according to its status; the other path calls routines with positions computed from a stored value.

name: setup_disk_or_display_entries
description: Chooses between two setups based on a state flag. One path builds two small structures with fixed values, calls a routine and writes the DMA control register according to its status; the other calls routines with positions computed from a stored value, and the text names a configuration file.

name: write_constants_to_indexed_element
description: Writes ten constant byte values in turn to the same element of a global array, indexed by the 16-bit argument times 10. Only the last value, 1, remains in that element.

name: enable_dma_and_report_error
description: Calls an unnamed routine that reports a status through a stack word, then writes the DMA control register to enable DMA channels. When the status is non-zero it calls a routine with the disk I/O error text.

name: swap_two_bytes
description: Exchanges the byte at the given address with the byte that follows it.

name: reverse_four_byte_block
description: Reverses four consecutive bytes by swapping the outer pair and the inner pair.

name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Writes the second byte of its 32-bit argument into a run of bytes. The count is given by the second argument, and the write happens at least once.

name: move_memory_block
description: Copies a number of bytes between two regions. It copies backwards when the destination is at or after the source, so overlapping regions are handled correctly.

name: enable_copper_and_dma
description: Writes the copper pointer and a DMA control value that sets bit 15 and enables copper and DMA bits. When a state flag is set it calls two routines first, then calls a routine with a fixed value and four more routines.

name: allocate_memory_block
description: Requests memory from a library function with two arguments. If the request returns zero, it calls an unnamed routine that reports that memory cannot be allocated, and it returns the request result.

name: call_three_subroutines_with_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine with no arguments, then calls another with its argument and a flag of 1, and finally calls the first routine again.

name: process_buffer_with_two_params
description: Passes a 60-byte local buffer with each of its two arguments to unnamed routines, then passes the buffer alone to an unnamed routine a third time.

name: clear_word_table
description: Sets each of the 64 16-bit entries of a global table to zero.

name: read_joystick_port_state
description: Reads the joystick or mouse port data register and the fire-button state, then combines them with a table of port flags into a 16-bit result of direction and button bits. It increments a counter on each call.

name: read_and_clear_global_byte
description: Increments a 16-bit counter and makes one call. It then returns the byte in a global variable, sets that variable to zero and makes a second call.
